'''3rd Regiment''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] formation based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tiems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 3rd Regiment fought in the [[Battle of Tiems]], attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops dug in throughout [[Gopps Forest]].
